svg.aria-label: Red Mesa Ancestral Caves measured plan
svg.text: Each 4.00 m rise uses two flights of 12 risers.
The middle landings are 1.82 m deep. The profile is unfolded.
The shelter roof closes above a level doorway.
The lower cave court sits below the records alcove.
The high chamber crossing bears on stone piers.
North apron → cave door → lower court → west shelf
